scheme_name: Loans and Advances for Construction of a House
other_conditions: The construction worker must be registered under the Manipur Building and Other Construction Workers' Welfare Board
The construction worker must have an active labour card
The applicant must submit a surety bond to the Board
The beneficiary must submit a completion certificate within six months of receiving the loan
benefits_summary: Provides loans of ₹1‑2 lakh for house construction with a 5% simple interest rate and a 5‑year repayment period.
